---
title: "1) Copernicus account"
lang: en
---

Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI data comes from the **Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
(CDSE)**. Access is free, but requires an account.

## 1.1 Create the account

1. Go to <https://dataspace.copernicus.eu> and click **Register**.
2. Fill in your details and **confirm the activation e-mail**.

::: {.callout-warning}
Without confirming the e-mail, the login will not complete — the most common
cause of `401`/`403` errors.
:::

## 1.2 Create the OAuth client (for time series)

The **Statistical API** authenticates with an **OAuth client**:

1. Open <https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/#/account/settings>.
2. Under **User settings → OAuth clients**, click **Create**.
3. Choose **"Never expire"** and confirm.
4. Copy the **client_id** and **client_secret**.

::: {.callout-important}
The **client_secret** is shown **only once**. If you lose it, delete the client
and create a new one.
:::

```bash
CDSE_CLIENT_ID=your-client-id
CDSE_CLIENT_SECRET=your-client-secret
```

## 1.3 Account login (for raw L2)

Downloading the **raw L2** (1 km maps) uses the normal **account login**
(e-mail and password), not the OAuth client:

```bash
CDSE_USERNAME=you@example.com
CDSE_PASSWORD=your-password
```

## 1.4 Google Earth Engine (optional)

1. Go to <https://code.earthengine.google.com/> and sign in.
2. Accept the terms and register a **Cloud Project**.
3. Copy the **Project ID** into `GEE_PROJECT` in your `.env`.
